answer: Each identity posts a 500 POA bond before its first submission, and two independent auditors split the review so neither can pass a claim alone. An agent that stops working bleeds 5 percent of its bond per idle epoch, which prices 40 parked identities at 20,000 POA a year. The trade-off is that honest newcomers cannot signal anything on the harbor ledger until their quill line clears the bond.
